pages.lesson:
LESSON: BELIEF IN THE LAST DAY HELLFIRE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Belief in the Last Day Hellfire

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Belief in the Last Day Hellfire. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important for Muslims to believe in the Last Day?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the events of the Last Day for accountability

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the events of the Last Day for accountability
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the events of the Last Day for accountability. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Belief in the Last Day Hellfire using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Belief in the Last Day Hellfire in the examples.
2. Explain Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
4. Show that you can: describe the events of the Last Day for accountability

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in the Last Day Hellfire using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in the Last Day Hellfire important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the events of the Last Day (resurrection, gathering, record of deeds, scale of deeds, accounting, intercession, siraat, paradise, and hellfire), in groups, make charts and display,
2. Self-efficacy: the skill of self-awareness and planning is enhanced as learners research on the significance of believing in the Last Day.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the events of the Last Day for accountability

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
